Splits product titles on ' - ' so 'Clark - Elastic Wallet' shows 'Clark' as the main name and 'Elastic Wallet' on a smaller muted line below. Falls back to the product's Type field when the title doesn't contain a dash.

settings.content: All siblings render in the track, sorted by tag priority (best sellers first). Overflow scrolls horizontally — drag on mobile, hover + wheel / arrow keys on desktop.

settings.label: Max swatches before +N
settings.info: Swatches beyond this show as a '+N' count linking to the product. Set to the maximum (12) to effectively show all.

settings.content: Circular semi-transparent quick-add button overlaid on the product card image. Clicking it adds the product directly (single-variant) or opens the quick-add popup (multi-variant).
